findings.expected: Check numeric article against previous suffix sort key as well as expected plain counter. [1,2-A,2] must expose suffix_order warning; [1,3-A,2] must fail article_order for backwards base.
findings.actual: Strict [1,2-A,2] and [1,3-A,2] both return valid=true,issues=[]. The same inputs with allow_article_gaps=true produce expected suffix_order and article_order respectively.
findings.mechanism: Successful plain-number branch updates previous_article without calling sort-key check. Suffix forward jump is not flagged in strict mode, and following plain number erases that ordering history.
findings.positive_control: [1,1-A,2] valid with no issues in strict and gap-tolerant modes.
findings.suggested_test: Exercise suffix-to-plain transitions in strict mode, including same-base descent and backwards-base descent; current committed test covers only plain-to-suffix descent.

findings.input: Se aplicará el artículo 1 de la “Ley” , vigente hasta el 31 de diciembre de 1990.
findings.mechanism: The attached-comma path now checks excluded_reading, but after trim_start only opening parenthesis gets equivalent handling; a whitespace-separated comma returns true as nonalphabetic punctuation.
findings.scope: One directly related whitespace normalization variant only; not a broader grammar search.
findings.suggested_test: The already-fixed quoted comma historical-modifier case should behave identically when whitespace precedes the comma.
